title: Shipment
description: Contains information pertaining to a shipment in an inbound plan.

amazonReferenceId.description: A unique identifier created by Amazon that identifies this Amazon-partnered, Less Than Truckload/Full Truckload (LTL/FTL) shipment.

placementOptionId.description: The identifier of a placement option. A placement option represents the shipment splits and destinations of SKUs.

selectedTransportationOptionId.description: Identifier of a transportation option. A transportation option represent one option for how to send a shipment.

selfShipAppointmentDetails.description: List of self ship appointment details.

shipmentConfirmationId.description: The confirmed shipment ID which shows up on labels (for example, `FBA1234ABCD`).

shipmentId.description: Identifier of a shipment. A shipment contains the boxes and units being inbounded.

status.description:
The status of a shipment. The state of the shipment will typically start as `UNCONFIRMED`, then transition to `WORKING` after a placement option has been confirmed, and then to `READY_TO_SHIP` once labels are generated.

Possible values: `ABANDONED`, `CANCELLED`, `CHECKED_IN`, `CLOSED`, `DELETED`, `DELIVERED`, `IN_TRANSIT`, `MIXED`, `READY_TO_SHIP`, `RECEIVING`, `SHIPPED`, `UNCONFIRMED`, `WORKING`

Address.description: Specific details to identify a place.

countryCode.description: The country code in two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

name.description: The name of the individual who is the primary contact.

AppointmentSlotTime.description: An appointment slot time with start and end.

endTime.description: The end timestamp of the appointment in UTC.

startTime.description: The start timestamp of the appointment in UTC.

Currency.description: The type and amount of currency.

code.description: ISO 4217 standard of a currency code.

Dates.description: Specifies the date that the seller expects their shipment will be shipped.

FreightInformation.description: Freight information describes the SKUs that are in transit. Freight carrier options and quotes will only be returned if the freight information is provided.

LtlTrackingDetail.description: Contains information related to Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) shipment tracking.

billOfLadingNumber.description: The number of the carrier shipment acknowledgement document.

freightBillNumber.description: The number associated with the freight bill.

availabilityType.description: The type of delivery window availability. Values: `AVAILABLE`, `BLOCKED`, `CONGESTED`, `DISCOUNTED`

deliveryWindowOptionId.description: Identifier of a delivery window option. A delivery window option represent one option for when a shipment is expected to be delivered.

editableUntil.description: The timestamp at which this Window can no longer be edited.

endDate.description: The end timestamp of the window.

startDate.description: The start timestamp of the window.

SelfShipAppointmentDetails.description: Appointment details for carrier pickup or fulfillment center appointments.

ShipmentDestination.description: The Amazon fulfillment center address and warehouse ID.

address.description: The address the shipment should be sent to. This can be empty if the destination type is `AMAZON_OPTIMIZED`.

destinationType.description: The type of destination for this shipment. Possible values: `AMAZON_OPTIMIZED`, `AMAZON_WAREHOUSE`.

warehouseId.description: The warehouse that the shipment should be sent to. This can be empty if the destination type is `AMAZON_OPTIMIZED`.

ShipmentSource.description: Specifies the 'ship from' address for the shipment.

sourceType.description: The type of source for this shipment. Possible values: `SELLER_FACILITY`.

SpdTrackingDetail.description: Contains information related to Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) shipment tracking.

spdTrackingItems.description: List of Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) tracking items.

SpdTrackingItem.description: Contains information used to track and identify a Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) item.

boxId.description: The ID provided by Amazon that identifies a given box. This ID is comprised of the external shipment ID (which is generated after transportation has been confirmed) and the index of the box.

trackingId.description: The tracking ID associated with each box in a non-Amazon partnered Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) shipment.

trackingNumberValidationStatus.description: Indicates whether Amazon has validated the tracking number. Because shipment validation is asynchronous, tracking IDs might not be validated immediately, and the status might change after a few hours. If more than 24 hours have passed and the status is not yet 'VALIDATED' or `NOT_SUPPORTED`, verify the number and update it if necessary. **Possible values:** `VALIDATED`, `NOT_VALIDATED`, `NOT_SUPPORTED` (Amazon is unable to find tracking information for the provided tracking ID).

TrackingDetails.description: Tracking information for Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) and Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) shipments.

Window.description: Contains a start and end DateTime representing a time range.

editableUntil.description: The timestamp at which this Window can no longer be edited.

end.description: The end timestamp of the window.

start.description: The start timestamp of the window.
